ModMetaData.name: Caravan Ghouls
ModMetaData.author: Nepenthe
ModMetaData.description:
This mod allows Ghouls to carry items when forming a caravan, allowing you to use your friendly ghouls as pack animals.
Don't forget to pack plenty of raw meat.
This is done by removing the code that flags mutants as being unable to ever carry anything, allowing an adult-sized ghoul to carry 35kg of items just like the rest of your colonists.
If combined with a mod that allows ghouls to pick up and use items like [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3223881925]Humanlike Ghoul[/url] this mod will prevent problems caused by the ghoul not being able to pick up items because of their weight.
New in version 1.1: the mod now has a settings page in Options -> Mod options where you can decrease or increase the carrying capacity of ghouls. Note that if you you have Vanilla Expanded Framework installed you need to enable the VFE fix right below the slider to prevent the weight modification from being applied twice. Or leave it unchecked and max out the slider so your ghouls can carry 30 tonnes of cargo, I'm not going to stop you.
This mod is safe to add/remove mid-save.
